name: drover
description: Autonomous GitHub Project board runner. Primary skills: drover, drover-build, drover-qa, drover-review, drover-collect. Secondary skills: visual, git-sync, ui-refine-loop, pr-security-review (Anthropic's PR security review, run by drover-qa on every PR). onboard also adds Cloudflare's standalone security-audit skill. Install with install.sh (links the drover command) and drover skills install; drover onboard writes the project's .drover/config.json.
